about: FrameQuality (Lazy Scan's FrameQualityTests, same in Swift and C#). Frames are the QualityFrames recipe: 320 x 240, a table (88, 80, 72), a sheet (205, 200, 192) from (80, 40) to (240, 200), print (95, 92, 100) as 2 px lines every 4 px with words of 7 px every 10 px inside (96, 56) to (224, 184), a box blur of (2 blur + 1)^2 kept inside the frame, then darkened by dim / 255. Pixel values are rounded half up. Readings are over the sheet unless region is null.

shutter.about: The sheet held still (1 px either way by frame parity, plus 70 px from frame 40) at 10 frames a second, 60 frames, confidence 0.9: blank blurred page for frames 0 to 11, dim printed page 12 to 17, sharp printed page after. Each frame measured over the page found.
